environment.description: Same application deployed on EKS with Thales Luna Network HSM (firmware 7.8.2) connected via PKCS#11 provider. JWT signing operations are delegated to HSM partition 'prod-auth-slot-3' with CKA_EXTRACTABLE=FALSE and CKA_SENSITIVE=TRUE on all private key objects. The JWT_SIGNING_KEY environment variable is NOT set (empty), forcing the code path through getHSMKey(). PostgreSQL connection uses IAM database authentication with a scoped policy that restricts the session to execute only prepared statements matching a registered query allowlist maintained in a pg_catalog extension (pg_query_fingerprint v2.1). The RDS proxy enforces that dynamic SQL segments not matching fingerprints 'a3f8c2d1', 'b7e4f901', '5c2a8d3e', 'f1b09c4a' are rejected with error code 42501. Additionally, the EKS pod runs with a seccomp profile (runtime/default augmented with custom BPF filter) that blocks ptrace and process_vm_readv syscalls, preventing memory inspection of the HSM PKCS#11 session handles.

config.hsm: Thales Luna Network HSM 7.8.2, partition prod-auth-slot-3, PKCS#11 provider, CKA_EXTRACTABLE=FALSE
config.database_proxy: RDS Proxy with IAM auth, query fingerprint allowlist enforcement (pg_query_fingerprint v2.1)
config.jwt_env: JWT_SIGNING_KEY is unset, JWT_VERIFY_KEY is unset, all crypto via HSM
config.network_policy: Calico NetworkPolicy restricts egress to RDS proxy endpoint only on port 5432
